function.name: lookup_patient_by_phone
function.description: Look up an active patient by the phone number they just provided. On the first call, send only phone_number; the server will not disclose record details. If a record is found and the caller's DOB is already collected and validated, call again with both values; otherwise ask for DOB first. Never reveal stored details unless identity_verified is true.

date_of_birth.description: Only on the second lookup, the caller's DOB in MM/DD/YYYY or ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

function.name: validate_field
function.description: Validate and normalize one collected field using the backend's authoritative rules. Call again only for the specific field that failed. Do not invent or fill missing values.

value.description: The caller-provided value for this field.

function.name: save_patient
function.description: Create a patient only after a fresh caller yes to the full read-back. Include only optional details the caller chose to provide. The server revalidates fields and prevents duplicate active phones. If the result has duplicate:true and identity_verified:true, do not retry save: tell the caller an existing record was found, ask whether they want to update, and require a fresh read-back confirmation before update. If identity_verified is false, disclose no record details and offer a callback.

caller_confirmation.description: Set to yes only after an explicit caller confirmation of the complete read-back.

date_of_birth.description: DOB as MM/DD/YYYY or ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update only the changed fields of an identity-verified returning patient, and only after the caller explicitly confirms the read-back of those changes. Do not send unchanged fields.

caller_confirmation.description: Set to yes only after an explicit caller confirmation of the read-back.

patient_id.description: The patient_id returned only after DOB verification.
